summary: Tested Enhanced Add Cash In flow with invoice integration. All 12 features working correctly: Step 1 (GST/NO GST selection), Step 2 (unpaid invoices list + Create New Invoice), Step 3 (payment details with 5 Payment Cycle options). Fixed API validation bug - frontend was sending 'invoice_type' but backend expected 'gst_type'. Complete E2E flow tested: Create Invoice -> Step 3 -> Add Income successfully updates dashboard totals.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed handleCreateInvoice - was sending invoice_type but backend InvoiceCreate model expects gst_type
Fixed date format - backend expects datetime.datetime, was sending date string
Fixed items format - added service_name field required by backend InvoiceItem model
All 3 steps working with proper back navigation via chevron-left buttons
Payment Cycle dropdown has all 5 options: One-Time, Monthly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly
Invoice creation auto-selects and proceeds to Step 3 with pre-filled amount
seed_data_creation: Created test invoices: 'Playwright Test Client' (INV-2026-0005, ₹1,18,000), 'E2E Test Company Ltd' (INV-2026-0006, ₹88,500)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Add Cash In 3-step wizard fully working. Step 1: GST/NO GST cards. Step 2: Lists unpaid invoices or shows 'No unpaid invoices' message + Create New Invoice button. Create Invoice modal has Client Name, Email, Due Date, Invoice Items with Add Item, Subtotal/Tax/Total calculations. Step 3: Date, Payment Type (Advance/Partial/Full), Payment Cycle (One-Time/Monthly/Quarterly/Half-Yearly/Yearly), Bank Account dropdown, Amount Received, Tax %. Add Income button records payment and updates dashboard. Back navigation works between all steps.
